reviewContext.issueReference: none (inline workflowInput; opus-terra-design-and-implement-review-loop-session-561; design accepted comm-010652 after DR-SSG2-01 fix; plan set accepted comm-010656 after PR-SSG2-06-FILTER revision comm-010655)
reviewContext.userProblem: <session-root>/runtime-records/runtime-message-log.sqlite grows to many GiB: inputSnapshot re-embeds upstream outputs (~93% of bytes), legacy rows store the session twice, retention had no default caps, the run-end vacuum is capped at 128 pages, and events serve never runs maintenance. Plus three operational defects: tests read the developer ~/.riela/config.json, riela gc fails on read-only expired snapshot directories, and storage compact --apply reports workRemaining true forever.
requiredOutcomes: Reduced execution payloads (fragment dedup) with >=5x synthetic benchmark, read parity across every public read path including nested, fail-closed sha256 verification (ssg2-01..03).

Bounded, lock-gated, terminal-only legacy conversion with cursor busy-retry and parking (ssg2-04), run after workflow runs and periodically in events serve/serve/RielaApp, with vacuum caps 4096/65536 (ssg2-05).
Reviewed built-in default retention (results/logs 30 days) and test isolation from the developer HOME (ssg2-06).
Read-only expired snapshot removal inside the store with unremovable paths as warnings, and workRemaining reflecting only conversion/reclamation work (ssg2-07).
doctor storage remainingBytes, NONE recovery path, parked-row visibility, and docs (ssg2-08).
nonGoals: No compression, Package.swift change, new dependency, version bump, release or push.
No bulk rewrite of generation-11 rows; no full VACUUM; no conversion of auto_vacuum=NONE stores.
No edits to EventLiveServe.swift, ServeHTTPCommand.swift, RielaCLIApplication.swift, GraphQL/SDL/catalog.
designDecisionsAndRationale: Fragment dedup instead of compression (design §3.1, §3.7): hoist inputSnapshot subtrees >= 1024 bytes into content-addressed workflow_runtime_payloads rows referenced by {"$rielaPayloadRef": sha256}; the CHECK(json_valid) constraint, the SQL json_extract readers and per-payload deflate's blindness to cross-payload repetition rule out codecs, and no Package.swift change is needed.

Generation 12 is additive DDL only (workflow_runtime_payload_refs table and index, design §3.2); no existing row is rewritten on open; top-level execution fields stay unchanged, so SQL readers keep working (§3.1 step 6).

Release ships in two parts (§3.2): the refs NOT EXISTS guard in ssg2-01 so a referenced fragment is never deleted, and the parent_digest cascade in ssg2-03; the internal write switch stays false until ssg2-03 so production never writes fragments that could leak.

Expansion happens only at the two assembly points, assembledSessionData and hydratedNestedSnapshot, with sha256 verification that fails closed with 'runtime payload fragment missing or corrupt' (§3.4).

Built-in default retention: results/logs maxAgeDays 30, messages follow results, applied per category through effectivePolicy(for:) with policySource provenance; the generated sweep is not defaulted, so restore points are never deleted by defaults (§4.1-4.4).

Automatic maintenance extends RunEndStorageMaintenance (no parallel mechanism): retention → bounded lock-gated terminal-only legacy conversion with keyset cursor in storage-maintenance.json → incremental vacuum capped at 4096 (runEnd) / 65536 (scheduled) pages, single-flight on automatic.lock (§5).

riela gc restores owner u+rwx only on euid-owned non-symlink directories inside the resolved collection root and reports unremovable paths as non-fatal warnings; storage compact workRemaining reflects only pending conversion/reclamation work (§10).
Test isolation uses CLIRuntimeEnvironment.$captured with a complete temporary environment through one shared helper, proven by a conflicting-HOME run (§11).
intentionalTradeoffs: Generation-11 canonical rows are not rewritten in bulk; they convert on their next save or age out under retention.
Older binaries reject generation-12 stores through the existing newer-generation error (required, they cannot expand references).
Stores without retention config start losing terminal families and log files older than 30 days on the first automatic pass after upgrade (documented behavior change).
Vacuum caps stay finite so one pass cannot hold the write lock indefinitely; large free lists shrink over several passes.
Parked legacy rows (3 failed conversions) are never retried automatically and stay readable; doctor storage reports them and storage compact --apply remains the manual path.
doctor storage remainingBytes is an upper bound (prune and compact can count the same legacy row).
supportedEdgeCases: Every on-disk representation stays readable: legacy inline session_json.executions, legacy CLI full copies, legacy embedded nested JSON, generation-11 full payloads, generation-12 reduced payloads.
inputSnapshot containing a literal $rielaPayloadRef key is stored unreduced (escape rule).
Missing or digest-mismatched fragments fail closed; no partial snapshot is returned.
Nested invocation parent/child payloads and reservations hydrate through hydratedNestedSnapshot.

Conversion outcome classes converted/notLegacy/nonTerminal/retired/busy/failed/parked with bounded busy (256), failed (256), parked (256 + overflow) lists, rescan after busy overflow, and corrupt or missing cursor restart.
Explicit session store equal to the user or project store is selected by resolved root; session resume/rerun/continue select by --scope.

Read-only expired snapshot trees (0555 dirs, 0444 files), symlinks pointing outside the collection root (link removed, target untouched), unremovable entry reported once as a warning with exit 0, dry run changes no mode.
storage compact: retention-warning-only store and a fully converted store report workRemaining false; a lock-held legacy session reports true; a live nested invocation does not set it.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Payload compression and bulk rewrite of generation-11 rows.
Full VACUUM or conversion of auto_vacuum=NONE stores by automatic maintenance (left to riela gc, session prune, storage compact --apply).
GraphQL, SDL and catalog changes; RielaMemory, definitions, KV, cache and memory stores.
Read-only handover files under an explicit store outside <home|project>/.riela are reported as warnings, not removed.
Reopening efficient-history eh-06/eh-07/eh-10 plans or the sgc-0* progress logs.
constraints: Preserve the uncommitted working-tree changes listed in the index; never checkout/restore/stash/reset them.
Never rewrite running/resumable sessions or retained-tree members; never take or break a held lock; never unlink live SQLite/WAL/SHM files.
Permission restoration only for euid-owned, non-symlink paths inside the resolved store root.
All swift build/test use HOME=$(mktemp -d) and an arm64 shell; tests use temporary stores and CLIRuntimeEnvironment.$captured isolation.
Build cache .build/ and .swiftpm/ writes are authorized and untracked; artifactRoots empty for every plan.
Workers edit only their writePaths/sharedPaths and their own progress log; no state-changing git.

residualRisks: Between ssg2-01 and ssg2-03 stale refs rows can leak fragments in test stores only; production switch default stays false until ssg2-03.
The isolation proof may expose leaks in suites outside the owned test files; such suites are listed as sharedPaths of ssg2-06 or reported for reconciliation.
